semantic_candidates.evidence: Six mutually orthogonal rectangular planes occur in three parallel pairs at separations 10, 20, and 30 millimetres.

validation_findings.evidence: Every cuboid edge has one of the positive analytic lengths 10, 20, or 30 millimetres.
Each of the twelve bounded edges is supported by an exact line.
The no-processing STEP round trip records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
Each of twelve unique edges is used by two of the six face wires, so the sole shell has no boundary edge.
The six oriented rectangular faces bound one connected three-dimensional cuboid component.
V-E+F equals 8-12+6=2 and every incidence has a finite exact analytic representation.

oracle.statement: A 10 by 20 by 30 millimetre cuboid has six rectangular planar faces, twelve unique straight edges, and eight vertices. Every edge belongs to two face wires, producing 24 edge and 48 endpoint occurrences. These counts and geometry classes follow from the construction, independently of classifier output.
